patch.value: changelog scripts read the pm workspace with default budgets instead of canonical complete reads

pm-changelog refuses changelogs generated from partial workspace reads. The changelog-family scripts in package.json invoked pm without --pm-bin and without unbounded output controls, so once this tracker exceeds a single page, changelog gates fail or would silently omit entries on older tool versions. Fix mirrors the pm-beads convention: pin ./node_modules/.bin/pm and request unbounded output.
All pm-changelog invocations perform the canonical complete unbounded workspace read; npm run changelog:check exits 0 on this head; no other scripts weakened
changelog gates always read the complete tracker and exit 0 whenever the committed changelog matches generated output
Scripts previously used default budgets; after adding --pm-bin and unbounded --pm-arg controls, npm run changelog:check exits 0
All pm-changelog invocations now perform the canonical complete unbounded workspace read; npm run changelog:check exits 0 on this head.
